review_kind: Fresh-context visual inspection and direct renderer repair
scope: R1 visual quality at 180 mm publication width; independent scientific audit is separate
first_inspection: Viewed the existing rendered figureR1_main.png before reading renderer source.

artifacts_viewed.inspection: Full figure before and after repair; final per-panel crops at export resolution
Before and after rasterization with pdftoppm; final 150 dpi image at 180 mm page width
Final XML dimensions/text check and visual inspection after system librsvg/cairo rasterization

issues_and_repairs.issue: The original horizontal resistors shared vertical rails and a circular bypass, visually communicating parallel branches rather than the requested series paths.
issues_and_repairs.repair: Replaced the schematic with a single unbranched closed loop. The across-domain and around-back resistors replace successive upper and lower arcs, with no chord, rails or bypass. A separate outer blue activity band marks the domain; blue edge nodes and the pulse arrow mark its boundaries. Reduced zigzag tooth count and positioned labels away from nodes for print legibility. Updated the schematic-only compact path CSV and generated legend wording.

issues_and_repairs.issue: The inset keys were the smallest text in the figure (5.4 and 5.1 pt).
issues_and_repairs.repair: Increased both inset keys to 5.8 pt and checked that the enlarged keys do not overlap measured curves or confidence intervals.

A.assessment: C20/C60 widths are proportional to circumference, time runs upward, shared greyscale and activity key are legible; axes and panel letter are clear.

B.assessment: Full analytic curves and the light-to-dark size key are legible, with clear axes and no overlap.

C.assessment: Both diffusivity facets retain paired C20/C60 kymographs with common time/activity scales, proportional widths, clear facet labels and one unobstructed activity key.

D.assessment: Shared x/y scales, both size curves, seed CI bands and labelled dashed guide are visible; enlarged inset key clears the curves.

E.assessment: Dose/displacement observations, slope lines and both size markers remain visible; high-dose departures remain on scale.

F.assessment: One domain, one edge pulse and the two series resistor segments are visually clear in one integrated ring schematic; all four labels clear the paths, nodes and arrow.

G.assessment: All seven diffusivity series and exact-ring points remain on scale; the key explicitly identifies colour as diffusivity, light slow/dark fast, and distinguishes points from law lines.

H.assessment: Three input facets share scales; circles/open squares and full CI bars remain distinct, with both guides labelled in the enlarged key. No clipping or overlap.

pdf.clipping: No visible clipping in rasterized export

svg.panel_letters: A B C D E F G H
svg.clipping: No visible clipping in rasterized export

export_checks.style: Uniform bold black 10 pt panel letters; plain black facet labels; left/bottom axes; thin lines and small markers; no figure title.

final_assessment: Every panel A–H passes visual inspection at 180 mm width in PNG, rasterized PDF and rasterized SVG. Scientific values, estimators and observed departures are preserved.
